title: Define seamless primary ChatGPT chat handoff protocol
goal: Define a repository-first procedure activated by a short human handoff phrase so the current primary ChatGPT audits live GitHub state, persists a fresh operational checkpoint, and produces a minimal bootstrap package that lets a fresh chat seamlessly assume the primary Senior Architect/orchestrator role without relying on prior-chat memory.
scope: Primary-maintainer documentation/process scope only: AGENTS.md, docs/CHAT_HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md, docs/AI_COLLABORATION_MODEL.md, docs/DEVELOPMENT_METHODOLOGY.md, docs/NEXT_CHAT_HANDOFF.md, docs/PROJECT_STATE.md, docs/INFRASTRUCTURE_LOG.md and docs/METHODOLOGY_JOURNAL.md.
Do not modify product/generator source, src/TiaV21Worker, workflows, runner configuration, secrets, vendor payloads, review schemas, delegated merge authority, or IndustrialMDE.

Document canonical trigger phrases including 'переходим в другой чат' and 'переходим в новый чат'. On such a trigger, primary ChatGPT must execute the handoff procedure without asking the user to reconstruct context already available in GitHub.

The handoff procedure must perform a live freshness audit: mandatory startup/governance/methodology documents, active trusted tasks, open PRs/issues, exact candidate SHAs, review state, relevant Actions/TIA evidence, pending external-review requests, and recent methodology telemetry relevant to current work.
Chat-only claims must not become durable state unless independently verified from GitHub. Stale repository snapshots must be corrected or explicitly marked stale/pending.

Handoff persistence must not silently invalidate an exact-SHA review already in flight. If a state update would necessarily move a relevant base/head or otherwise stale evidence, the invalidation and required fresh gate must be durably recorded before handoff.

Operational checkpoint updates are factual state synchronization only. Normative architecture, authorization, reviewer-policy, risk-waiver or project-goal changes remain separate task/review work and must not be smuggled into a handoff checkpoint.

The final old-chat response must include a compact bootstrap prompt for the fresh chat; the fresh chat is instructed to verify GitHub live, execute AGENTS.md startup, assume the primary role, process pending authorized work, and keep IndustrialMDE out of scope.

requirements: A versioned docs/CHAT_HANDOFF_PROTOCOL.md defines trigger phrases, pre-handoff audit, persistence surfaces, stale-evidence handling, output contract and fresh-chat startup contract.
AGENTS.md documents the handoff command semantics and points to the protocol.
AI_COLLABORATION_MODEL.md documents that primary-chat replacement is a repository-first role transfer rather than memory transfer.
DEVELOPMENT_METHODOLOGY.md adds the reusable rule that chat handoff is a transactional freshness checkpoint: audit, persist, then transfer.

NEXT_CHAT_HANDOFF.md is refreshed from live GitHub and uses a concise checkpoint structure including trusted main SHA, active work/gates, exact candidate SHA(s), pending reviewer/user actions, blockers and next safe action.
PROJECT_STATE.md is refreshed from live GitHub where currently stale and distinguishes durable completed milestones from active live gates.
INFRASTRUCTURE_LOG.md and METHODOLOGY_JOURNAL.md receive concise factual entries for this protocol and the material lesson that a handoff must detect stale state/evidence before transfer.
No secrets, vendor payloads, human signing private material or unnecessary raw logs are copied into handoff artifacts.
Exact candidate receives green deterministic CI and one fresh independent chatgpt-secondary review because primary ChatGPT authors the candidate.
tia: No Windows/TIA execution is required for this documentation/process task.
The task must not modify or execute TIA worker code or alter the trusted Windows boundary.
